# Savyavasa Dharmawangsa

> Savyavasa Dharmawangsa is a 3-tower, 41-floor, 402-unit luxury residential development at Jl. Dharmawangsa IX, Kebayoran Baru, South Jakarta 12160. Developed by PT Jantra Swarna Dipta — a joint venture between Swire Properties (Hong Kong) and JSI Group (Indonesia). Architecture by SCDA Architects (Singapore), interiors by Yabu Pushelberg and Richardson Sadeki, landscape by Intaran Design (Bali). First Jakarta residential project certified Green Mark Gold by Singapore's BCA. Indoor air PM 2.5 filtered. Smart home by Habitap — Indonesia's first AI-integrated residence. Pet friendly. Siap huni.

## Pricing (Before Tax) — Tower 2 & 3

- 4BR 264 sqm: IDR 17.5 billion (USD 1,073,600) — 1 unit remaining, Tower 2, mid-floor, SCBD view
- 3+1BR 254 sqm: IDR 16.8 billion (USD 1,030,700)
- 3BR 195/197 sqm: IDR 12.7 billion (USD 779,100)
- 2BR 131/133 sqm: IDR 8.5 billion (USD 521,500)

After-tax pricing includes VAT 11% and Super Luxury Tax 1%. Additional: BPHTB 5%, notary 0.375% (local) / 0.475% (foreigner). USD rate: IDR 16,300/USD.

## Key Facts

- Developer: PT Jantra Swarna Dipta (Swire Properties × JSI Group)
- Location: Jl. Dharmawangsa IX, Kebayoran Baru, South Jakarta 12160
- Towers: 3 towers × 41 floors = 402 units
- Landscape: 3 hectares, 230+ trees, 1km jogging trail, urban forest
- Certification: Green Mark Gold (BCA Singapore) — first in Jakarta
- Smart Home: Habitap — first AI-integrated residence in Indonesia
- Architecture: SCDA Architects (Singapore)
- Interior: Yabu Pushelberg (Toronto/New York) + Richardson Sadeki (New York)
- Landscape: Intaran Design (Bali)
- Pet Friendly: Yes — on-site pet care, forest walking trails
- Air: PM 2.5 filtration at source
- Water: Drinkable tap water (BWT Germany)
- Parking: Multiple assigned private bays, EV charging stations
- Status: Siap huni (move-in ready)
- Foreigner Ownership: Permitted with valid immigration documents
